cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "Another one's gone. Not one of the easy ones. One of ours — one we did everything for."
She has the ledger open. She runs a finger down the column for that vein and stops at the bottom, where nothing's missing.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "That one shouldn't have gone. We did everything right for that one."
She isn't upset. She's doing the sum again, slower, like it might come out different.
Des reads it over her shoulder, twice. He opens his mouth, closes it again, and goes back to the top of the column.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "I don't know. I genuinely don't. It should've been the last one they tried."
